text: ok so I've been on hold on the phone for ages and gave up so I'm texting instead. mum's on night shift and I'm minding my little brother Jack, he's 6. He's been whinging about a sore throat since this arvo but he's drinking heaps, he had like two cups of water and a juice popper, so I reckon he's fine on that front?? Then about an hour ago he was mucking around and bumped his head on the corner of the kitchen table. He cried straight away, really loud, and I gave him a cuddle and some ice wrapped in a tea towel. Now he's acting completely normal, back to annoying me and wanting to play on the iPad like nothing happened. I think he's ok but I'm not 100% sure and mum's not answering her phone, and I don't want to get in trouble if I was meant to do something. Do I need to take him somewhere or is it ok to just keep an eye on him? Sorry if this is a dumb question, I just honestly don't know what's normal for head stuff.
